gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects must have high radiological likelihood of GBM with plan for resection/biopsy for histologically confirmed GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: Our study will use Daratumumab, an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody, in combination with TMZ and RT in newly diagnosed GBM patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Our study will use Daratumumab, an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody, in combination with TMZ and RT in newly diagnosed GBM patients.
Patients who received prior treatment for GBM.

role_evidence.quote: Daratumumab will be administered by IV infusion to subjects in combination with current therapeutic strategies of surgical resection followed by a course of Temozolomide and radiation therapy.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: therapeutic targeting of CD38 in GBM and its microenvironment

role_evidence.quote: TMZ is a standard therapy for GBM.
Daratumumab will be administered by IV infusion to subjects in combination with current therapeutic strategies of surgical resection followed by a course of Temozolomide and radiation therapy.

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it with RT as standard backbone. Brief summary mentions daratumumab 'has attained therapeutic CSF levels' as background rationale only; no tumour/CSF PK planned.
